<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="tE6OakmLCih9d80gD0Vm"> <mxGraphModel grid="1" page="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
' Logical view of the EduCycle System
' Layers: Presentation, Application, Data, and External Services

skinparam packageStyle folder
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam ranksep 50
skinparam nodesep 50
skinparam componentStyle uml2

package \"Presentation Layer\" {
 [React Native UI] as UI
 [Navigation] as Nav
}

package \"Application Layer\" {
 [Use Cases (Sell/Trade/Lend)] as UC
 [State Management] as State
}

package \"Data Layer\" {
 [Repositories] as Repo
 [Local Cache (AsyncStorage)] as Cache
}

package \"External Services\" {
 [Firebase (Auth/DB)] as Firebase
 
}

' Layout and Relationships
UI -down-> State
Nav -down-> UC

State -down-> Repo
UC -down-> Repo

Repo -down-> Firebase
Repo -down-> Cache


note top of UI : JavaScript
